### Summary

This section keeps the selector of the lateral covariance correction and the registered arms that exercise it;
the identity behind the correction, the face moments and the telescoping argument are in @sec-ch04-fluxcov and
are not repeated here. The default matters for every reader of a deck: a run that leaves the variable unset
gets the correction, and a run that sets the variable gets what it sets.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Selects the lateral correction of @eq-ch04-fluxcov-dF.

**Data.** Face states and radial moments in; hydro and tracer flux corrections out.

**Placement.** Each lateral flux and its matching geometric source, every stage.

**Activation.** `SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE`, default on; `0` disables it.

**Guarantee / limits.** Leading $O(\Delta x_1^2)$ correction; no fourth-order guarantee.

**Evidence.** Tests below, @tbl-ch12-flux-covariance-tests; solver ctests were not run.
:::

Local symbols: $\Delta x_1$ is the radial cell width [m]; the face correction has the units of its flux row.

### Derivation

See @sec-ch04-fluxcov for the covariance identity, the face centroid term and the exact telescoping of a shared
face flux. The chapter's check line `[C4]` re-derives the linear covariance identity, the mass-weighted mean
and the two-cell cancellation independently [check `src/snapy_report/ch12/checks/configuration_check.py`, output
`src/snapy_report/ch12/checks/configuration_check.out`].

### Numerical method

`HydroImpl::flux_covariance` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::flux_covariance >}}) reads the variable once
and caches the boolean. On each hydro call `HydroImpl::forward` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}})
builds, for each lateral direction with more than one cell and an enabled flux, the correction from the face
states with `_flux_covariance` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::_flux_covariance >}}), adds it to
that direction's flux, keeps the face states for the passive scalars, and lets the geometric source of a
corrected direction use the pressure shifted by the centroid term; a grid whose face centroid shift is
identically zero (Cartesian) keeps the plain source. A passive scalar gets the tracer row of a hydro species
with the same mass fraction through `scalar_flux_covariance`
({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::scalar_flux_covariance >}}), consumed in `ScalarImpl::forward`
({{< code src/scalar/scalar.cpp ScalarImpl::forward >}}). With the correction on, the species and scalar donor
limiters of @sec-ch08 run even when the EOS[^rg-fe974e22df0a] limiter is off. No separate MPI synchronization is introduced by this
switch.

```{python}

#| fig-alt: "cell centroid; face centroid: shift; x1 covariance + shift; x2 or x3 flux; matching source gate."
```

### Code

**How to use it.** Leave FC unset for its default, or set `SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE=1` explicitly before launch.
Use a new process with `SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE=0` for the control. In a complete multidimensional card,
this fragment leaves both lateral flux directions active:

<!-- reader glossary keys -->Keys in this fragment: `dynamics`[^rg-01ca350389d0], `disable-flux-x2`[^rg-8a0da0d80715], `disable-flux-x3`[^rg-527913df4a33].
```yaml
dynamics:
  disable-flux-x2: false
  disable-flux-x3: false
```

There is no setup refusal for an unavailable covariance stencil: fewer than three radial cells or a shallow-water
state give no correction. A collapsed or disabled lateral direction also supplies no corrected flux.

`HydroImpl::forward` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}) contains this selection step:

```cpp
      priemann->forward(wlr2[ILT], wlr2[IRT], DIM2, _flux2);
      if (dcov.defined()) _flux2 += dcov;
      cov2 = dcov.defined();
```

`dcov` is the additive face term of @eq-ch04-fluxcov-dF, built from the states before the Riemann call.
These lines add it to the computed flux and record whether the matching source needs correction.
The shared-face cancellation checked by `[C4]` requires both cells to use that same flux.

| what | code link | symbol | switch |
|---|---|---|---|
| flag and default | {{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::flux_covariance >}} | `get_env` | `SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE` |
| correction | {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::_flux_covariance >}} | `_flux_covariance` | `SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE` |
| apply | {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}} | `cov2` | `SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE` |
| source | {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}} | `face_centroid_shift_zero` | `SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE` |
| scalar row | {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::scalar_flux_covariance >}} | `scalar_flux_covariance` | `SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE` |
| scalar apply | {{< code src/scalar/scalar.cpp ScalarImpl::forward >}} | `lateral` | `SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE` |

: Implementation sites for the flux-covariance selector. {#tbl-ch12-flux-covariance-code}

1. Read the switch once, on unless set to a false token or empty. The anchor `get_env` is in
   {{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::flux_covariance >}}.
2. Per lateral direction, build the correction from the face states and add it to the flux; correct that
   direction's source. The anchor `cov2` is in {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}.
3. Give each passive scalar its own tracer row from the same face states. The anchor `lateral` is in
   {{< code src/scalar/scalar.cpp ScalarImpl::forward >}}.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
No new order fit is supplied. The centroid term does not vanish for a moving isothermal state on a curved grid;
exact rest needs zero velocity. The correction across MPI-rank seams and XC together with FC have no registered
numerical evidence.

The complete switch inventory is @sec-ch12-matrix.
:::
